propositions: A four-operation RichTextCodec Protocol must be defined to abstract rich-text handling differences between Jira Cloud (ADF) and Data Center (wiki markup) without duplicating map_fields_to_remote

AdfCodec and WikiTextCodec must implement identical four-operation contracts (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) as separate primitives to preserve distinct Cloud call paths that compose them differently

The shared map_fields_to_remote implementation must be relocated to adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py with RichTextCodec as a constructor dependency, and AdfCodec must remain in adapters/jira/rich_text_codec.py to enforce the import contract
WikiTextCodec must truncate at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT=32767 with truncation marker matching adf._ADF_TRUNCATION_SUFFIX, and both codecs must handle None by returning empty string
Exactly one real implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in the tree under jira_family; all prior Cloud and DC versions must delegate to it or be removed

Cloud behavior must be proven unchanged by J1 pinned oracles, verified by asserting AdfCodec.fit_outbound and to_wire match pre-story adf.py outputs, and normalize_outbound(fit_outbound(v)) matches pre-story _fit_description(v)
